'''Mathieu Kociak''' is a French researcher of [[nano-optics]] at the [[French UMR]] [[Laboratoire de Physique des Solides]].<ref name=lpsProfile>{{cite web|url= https://equipes2.lps.u-psud.fr/stem/user/mathieu.kociak |title=Mathieu Kociak|accessdate=August 15, 2023}}</ref><ref name=upsProfile>{{URL|https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en/mathieu-kociak}}</ref>

He obtained his Ph.D. from the [[Université Paris-Sud]] in 2001 in [[carbon nanotube]]s, [[plasmon]]s and [[superconductivity]], under the supervision of [[Christian Colliex]].<ref>
{{cite thesis | type=PhD thesis | last=Kociak | first=Mathieu  | publisher=[[Université Paris-Sud]] |url=https://theses.fr/2001PA112101 | title=Supraconductivite et plasmons dans les nanotubes | year=2001 | oclc=1164563489 | language=fr | page=}}</ref> He later did a post-doc at [[Meijo University]].<ref>{{URL|https://www.linkedin.com/in/mathieu-kociak-093b227a}}</ref>

He is the author of numerous [[peer-review]]ed articles which have appeared in such journals as ''[[Nano Letters]]'' and ''[[Physical Review Letters]]'' among others.<ref name=lpsProfile />

==Awards==
Some awards bestowed to Kociak are listed below:<ref name=upsProfile />
* ''[[Guinier Prize]]'' from the [[French Physical Society]] (2002)
* ''FEI-EM'' award from the [[European Microscopy Society]] (2012)
